headline: Oprah Winfrey transfers ownership of South African academy to government
summary: American media icon Oprah Winfrey has decided to transfer ownership of her South African girls' academy to the South African government, fulfilling her long-standing educational commitment.
why: Philanthropic institutional handovers impact public sector social infrastructure responsibilities and state-managed educational resource allocations.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Transfer of academy ownership to the South African government.
